events.headline: Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline stays largely shut after Houthi strikes force export halts and cargo cancellations; oil jumps to 2026 highs (WTI $105.83, Brent $108.75) as Libya's NOC also suspends output at three oilfields amid protests

Federal Reserve raises target federal funds rate 25bp to 3.75%-4.00%, the first hike since 2023, citing inflation near 3.4% YoY that energy-driven price shocks from the Iran war have kept above target; Chair Warsh signals more hikes may follow
Broadcom guides to $115B in AI semiconductor revenue for fiscal 2027 and $230B by fiscal 2028, citing secured supply and demand from OpenAI and Anthropic, extending the AI-chip capex supercycle

Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron report memory production sold out through 2027 and TSMC expands chipmaking-equipment capacity fivefold this year, unable to keep pace with AI hyperscaler demand for custom silicon and HBM
